# Hemra

> Hemra is a free research and education tool that uses machine learning to compare a microscope image of a white blood cell to four learned cell types (eosinophil, lymphocyte, monocyte, neutrophil). It runs entirely in the web browser, so images are never uploaded. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose any condition.

Website: https://hemraresarch.teddyaaron.com/
Built by: Teddy Aaron (https://hemraresarch.teddyaaron.com/founder.html, https://teddyaaron.com)
Owner: Teddy Aaron Ventures LLC
Sister project: Cathra (https://www.cathra.dev), which compares ovarian ultrasound images to normal and abnormal patterns in the browser

## Results (research results, not clinical performance)
- 3,840 training images and 960 held-out test images (240 per class), from Acevedo et al. 2020 (CC BY 4.0).
- 936 of 960 test images classified correctly (97.5%).
- All figures are from images in the same dataset as the training data. Accuracy on images from other hospitals, stains, or microscopes has not been measured.

## Intended use
Research and education only. Not for diagnosis or any medical decision.
